title: fix(pm): the blocker renderers name a merged PR target merged, carried from blockerResolutionFromRow
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D57th1DjnPnDwHnt13w9sns)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyoPqu4bmhNDvUMnAb

Fixes #28083

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改措辞，不改任何判定。`Blocked-by:` 指向一个已合并的 PR 时，H19、H26、H28 这三行和 H4 的散文候选列表现在写「merged 日期」，不再写与关单 issue 同一个词的「closed」。关而未合并的 PR 仍写「closed UNMERGED」，issue 仍写「closed」。H28 的图例跟着改成「已合并的 PR 读作 merged」。顺带把 H28 一枚钉子改钉到新句子「spent either way」上。只改 1 个文件 `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`。
- 为什么改：这是 PR #28074 契约复核的 should-fix 1–2。#28074 之后定时全量跑和 H28 已经写「merged」，但真正点名目标的两个渲染器还把合并的 PR 印成「closed」，读 H19 或 H4 的人分不清它是合并了的 PR 还是关掉的 issue，得点开才知道。
- 风险与回滚：探测跨新旧两棵树做了穷举，9 种目标状态、219 种组合、3 种正文/评论承载，共 3066 行：判定、计数、分支全部逐字一致，变的 612 个字符串全部只是「closed→merged」这一个词。消融一腿（把 merged 标记强制关掉）恰红 6 枚新钉。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：`blockerResolutionFromRow`（多一行 `merged`），再看 `namedTargets` 与 `namedProseCandidates` 各一行三元选词。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`，预期 exit 0、5130 例通过（主干 5113）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。本 PR 不碰四个契约面，不欠契约复审；落地档以登记册为准（本地 `--test` 读为不受管，普通队列落地）。

## What changes

- **`blockerResolutionFromRow`** carries `merged: true` for a closed PR whose `pull_request.merged_at` is set, the same field `unmerged` reads and the same row key `scheduled-full-run.mjs`'s `judgeCardBlock` carries. It is set only when the state is `closed` and `merged_at` is truthy, so it never sits beside `unmerged: true`, and an issue (no `pull_request` key) carries neither. A row without it keeps its exact shape (the key is spread in only when true).
- **`namedTargets`** (H19's expiry and partial rows, H26, H28) renders a merged PR as `` `#N` (merged DATE) ``, or `` `#N` (merged) `` with no close time. An abandoned PR stays `(closed UNMERGED DATE)`, an issue stays `(closed DATE)`.
- **`namedProseCandidates`** (the H4 prose candidate list) renders a merged PR as `` `#N` MERGED (DATE) `` in that list's own case, beside its existing `CLOSED`, `CLOSED UNMERGED`, `UNRESOLVED` and `open`.
- **H28 legend**: `an issue reads closed, a merged PR reads merged, and a PR that closed UNMERGED is named so` replaces the line that explained a bare `closed` on a PR, since the renderer now says it itself.
- **Pins**: the H28 firing pin for the abandoned body target now tests `spent either way` (the sentence #28074 added) instead of `the body line is `, which the pre-existing `so the body line is STALE` also matched. New pins: the resolver's `merged` mark on the five row shapes (merged, abandoned, closed PR with no `merged_at`, open PR, issue), merged and unmerged never on one row, the key absent when false; H19's merged row named `(merged DATE)` and never `(closed`, the no-date form, a merged PR beside an abandoned one (same PARTIAL verdict, each named by what its close meant); H4 prose `MERGED (DATE)` and the bare form, with an issue control; H28 with a merged spent body target, its legend, and an issue control.

## Why

Should-fixes 1 and 2 of the contract review of PR #28074 (record 6522135235), filed as #28083 and triaged p3 (6523393934: wording only, the two renderers print merged for a merged PR target carried from `blockerResolutionFromRow`, the cosmetic pin rides along, no new gate). Measured on `origin/main` `47a8b5882` before the change: `blockerResolutionFromRow` carried `unmerged` only, so both renderers printed a merged PR and a closed issue with the same word; H28 compensated with a legend, and H19, H26 and the H4 prose list did not.

Item 3 of the card (the optional `platform-readings.md` measured-leg line for `issue_read` on a PR number) is not in this PR: that file is at 458 of 458 lines, the line would need a paid same-file deletion, and the claim (6523870001) leaves it on the card for a later pass. The card closes on this PR because its two wanted items landed and the third was conditional on headroom, as #28074 did with its own optional item.

## Verification

- Self-test on the committed head: `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` exit 0, 5130 cases (base 5113; 17 new pins), battery `H19 PR target merge reading` 26/16.
- Ablation on the committed head through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `const merged = state === 'closed' && Boolean(row?.pull_request?.merged_at);` → `const merged = false; // ABLATION`, anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1): exit 1, 6 of 5130 red, every one a new merged-wording pin (H4 prose ×2, H19 ×4); restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Before/after probe (`skills-lane-seat2/28083/probe.mjs` in the project files) importing both trees, `origin/main` `47a8b5882` and this head: 9 target kinds (merged PR, merged PR with no close time, abandoned PR, closed issue, open issue, open PR, open `pm:on-hold`, open `pm:blocked`, unresolved) in every multiset of size 1 to 3 (219), under three carriers (all in the body, first in the body and the rest comment-borne, comment-only), driven through `h19BlockOutlivedBlocker`, `h19DeclaredExitFired`, `h26BlockOnIndefiniteTarget`, `h28StaleBodyBlockerLine` and `proseBlockerClause` (with and without a held-back count): 3066 rows, 0 verdict differences (null-versus-row, sentence branch and every count identical), 0 resolution-row differences with `merged` stripped, `merged` never beside `unmerged`; 612 rows differ as strings and every one of them is identical after mapping `merged`→`closed` and the H28 legend back.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) on the file: exit 0.
- Landing tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` answers 0 of 1 paths on the register (not governed, ordinary queue landing); the register's reading at PR time is the seat's.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` at the committed head `cee17c03` derives 47 families (37 by path, 2 by change kind, 8 whole-tree); all 47 run in a second worktree at the same tree (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` first, 27 s), exit codes recorded before any pipe, every one 0 (includes `check:pm-half-states`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `check:pm-post-stamped`, `scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`, `board-snapshot.mjs --self-test`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`); `--ran` reconciles 47 derived / 47 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN, and the derivation re-run at the final head is identical. No changeset derived: no published package is touched, `skip-changeset` rides the create. Not measured locally: repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the type-check lanes (CI's).

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the one Chinese channel).
